decisions.decision: Add strength prop to MeshGradient with default 0.15
decisions.rationale: User feedback: cursor pull at hardcoded 0.05 felt too subtle. Mirrors DotField's strength pattern. Spec §5.2 doesn't list a strength prop but §5.1 contract permits component-specific props.

User reported black ellipses at corners when blur < 0.1. Float32 overflow at the singularity. Clamp prevents NaN-poisoning the normalized weighted sum. Saved to memory at project_matter_float32_overflow_in_inverse_distance.md.

decisions.decision: Centralize cursor canvas-rect normalization in CursorInput + useCursor
decisions.rationale: User noticed cursor effect was offset from pointer in DotField. CursorInput originally normalized against viewport (window.innerWidth/Height). Fixed in 3.2 by adding `element` option to CursorInput; useCursor passes the parent canvas automatically. All M3 components inherit the fix without per-component plumbing.
